text:
Alex: seeing a 3x p99 spike on prod-rt (us-west) around 02:15 UTC, lasted ~12m. throughput down ~40%. tagging eng-runtime

Priya: on it. any alert links?

Alex: https://grafana.redwood/d/rt/prod-latency?panel=5 - lots of streaming responses in `send loop` state.

Matt: pulling a perf profile from rtd-07: `rdtrace collect --pid 1123 --duration 30s -o /tmp/profile.pb` will paste when done.

Sasha: Datadog shows request_size p50->p99 jump 1.2kB -> 98kB. KV-cache eviction_rate +6x. Looks like large prompt growth.

perf-bot: host=rtd-07 metric=kernel_fallback_events value=5400 window=15m

Lina: traced back many requests to tenant `acme-inc` (tenant_id=54). client side started a recursive tool-call pattern that re-enters generation and streams -> prefix keeps growing.

Alex: aha, tool-loop explains the size spike and cache churn.

Matt: profile shows hotspots in `select_kernel_for_request()`: a lot of requests falling back to `generic_attn` at seq_len ~512. Heuristic from commit abc123 misfires when token_count_estimator undercounts tool output.

Sasha: stack snippet: 
```
select_kernel_for_request(req) {
  if (req.seq_len > heuristic_limit && !quantized) {
    use fused_kernel;
  } else {
    use generic_attn; // many requests hit this branch unexpectedly
  }
}
```

Priya: so chain: tool-loop -> prefix growth -> estimator misreports -> generic kernel chosen -> throughput drops -> KV evictions -> backpressure -> clients retry -> amplification.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy runtime-v2.1 started at 2026-03-18T02:10:00Z for pool rtd-pool-canary

Lina: most affected requests are on canary nodes running v2.1 (confirmed by request routing logs).

Matt: repro'd locally with synthetic tool-loop script (gist: https://gist.github.com/xxx/tool-loop-repro). Repro triggers kernel fallback and queue buildup.

Alex: what are immediate mitigations?

Sasha: short-term: add router-level regex throttling for the offending tool invocation for tenant 54 and apply a per-tenant rate-limit (10 req/min) on canary nodes. Also rate-limit streaming chunk size to limit prefix growth.

Priya: I'll roll the canary back to v2.0 on the affected pool now.

perf-bot: rollback initiated on rtd-pool-canary nodes

Matt: working on heuristic fix: switch to measured_token_count fallback and clamp kernel choice when observed seq_len_growth > 100 tokens/request. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/452

Alex: also propose KV-cache admission control: cap per-tenant inserts to 2000/min to prevent eviction storms.

Lina: filing incident: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0318-rt-latency

Priya: postmortem owner = @Matt. Action items: rollback (done), tenant rate-limit, heuristic patch, cache caps, add alert for kernel-fallback-rate > 1000/min, add test for tool-output token estimator.

Matt: will push hotfix + tests. ETA ~2h.

Alex: thanks all. we'll sync tomorrow in #eng-runtime for a deeper RCA and follow-ups.

Sasha: :thumbsup:
